gqm.goal: For formatter users, preserve valid Go source while applying the documented struct-literal transformation.
questions: Does formatting retain parseable Go and leave unsupported literal kinds unchanged?

rating.pass_condition: Required applicable contract tests pass and no confirmed regression remains.

gqm.goal: For file-modifying CLI users, prevent partial or unintended source changes when selection, parsing, or writing fails.
questions: Are only documented files selected and are failed updates recoverable?

rating.pass_condition: Applicable selection and write-safety evidence passes; no data-loss or partial-write defect is confirmed.

gqm.goal: For CLI and linter-plugin consumers, preserve documented flags, streams, exit statuses, diagnostics, and configuration behavior.
questions: Does a public contract change break an existing documented consumer?

rating.pass_condition: Applicable contract tests pass and compatibility review finds no unapproved breaking change.

gqm.goal: For maintainers, keep parser, formatter, CLI, and plugin responsibilities understandable and independently changeable.
questions: Are unrelated reasons to change coupled across or within these boundaries?

rating.pass_condition: No confirmed major boundary finding remains without an accepted exception.

gqm.goal: For maintainers, make behavior regressions detectable with deterministic tests that assert observable contracts.
questions: Do changed success, failure, and boundary behaviors have meaningful and isolated evidence?

rating.pass_condition: Required tests pass and no applicable high-priority risk lacks a justified test or analysis.

analysis_skills.name: requirements-review
analysis_skills.evidence: README.md, AGENTS.md, TESTING.md, Makefile, and CLI tests define observable formatter and file-update contracts; no conflicting requirement was found.

analysis_skills.name: architecture-review
analysis_skills.evidence: Source inspection and graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md show intentional formatter, CLI, and plugin package boundaries with no import cycle.

analysis_skills.name: change-impact-review
analysis_skills.evidence: Public consumers are standard input/output, file paths, Git diff selection, CLI flags and exit statuses, and the golangci-lint module plugin.

analysis_skills.name: security-review
analysis_skills.evidence: The input boundary is Go source and filesystem paths; no authentication, secrets, personal data, network service, or privilege boundary was found in production code.

analysis_skills.name: whitebox-risk-based-test
analysis_skills.evidence: Traced Parse -> FormatStructLiterals -> Print, CLI file/diff/write paths, and plugin analyzer paths to prioritize syntax preservation, selection, and recovery tests.

analysis_skills.name: review-orchestrator
analysis_skills.evidence: Selected requirements, architecture, change-impact, security, API compatibility, and test-quality review scopes; data, privacy, concurrency, performance, observability, and release reviews were not applicable to the current product boundary.

analysis_skills.name: api-compatibility-review
analysis_skills.evidence: The README, cmd/gostructfmt/main.go, cmd/gostructfmt/main_test.go, and plugin/gostructfmt define CLI and module-plugin contracts. No current breaking change was under review; future public-contract changes require this review.

analysis_skills.name: test-quality-review
analysis_skills.evidence: Existing tests use testify and t.Run with deterministic temp-directory fixtures for CLI file operations; the baseline requires focused observable tests for changed behavior.

mechanical_checks.when: Go code affecting concurrency, shared state, or lifecycle changes
source, test, documentation, or configuration changes
Go source, tests, tooling, or configuration changes

must_quality.rule: Requested behavior is satisfied and demonstrated by tests or evidence
Existing supported behavior is not unintentionally broken
Repository-local guidance and public contracts are respected
No critical security defect is introduced
Formatter changes preserve valid Go source and documented literal scope.
File selection and write failures do not cause unintended or partial source updates.
CLI and plugin contract changes are tested and require an explicit compatibility decision.

performance_quality.rule: Keep responsibilities, names, and tests easy to evolve

critical_defects: Data loss, corruption, or unsafe migration
Required behavior missing or public API broken without approval
Formatter emits invalid Go source or unexpectedly rewrites source outside its documented scope
File selection or write behavior causes unintended or partial source updates
assumptions: No calibrated numeric threshold is used: this small Go CLI has no comparable benchmark population. Required factors use documented pass/fail contracts and preserve leaf-level evidence.
make fmt and make lint may modify files; they are required repository workflows, but a gate must report any resulting diff rather than treating a non-clean worktree as a quality failure.
The current baseline establishes policy only. .quality/state.json remains NOT_RUN until a quality assessment executes the applicable checks.
